components.name: MenuIcon
components.doc: Menu to close: the outer lines slide to the middle as they rotate into an X, and the middle line folds away.

components.name: PlayPauseIcon
components.doc: Play to pause: the triangle splits into two halves that straighten into bars.

components.name: PlusCheckIcon
components.doc: Plus to check: each bar swings its ends to become one leg of the check.

components.name: CopyCheckIcon
components.doc: Copy to check: the back sheet tucks under the front one, the front one settles away, and the check draws in.

components.name: SunMoonIcon
components.doc: Sun to moon: the disc grows while a shadow slides across it from the corner, carving the crescent, and the rays turn and fold in. The crescent is drawn as an outline: the disc's edge outside the shadow, and the shadow's edge inside the disc.

components.name: ChevronIcon
components.doc: A chevron that turns on a spring, for disclosure and sort controls.

components.name: BellIcon
components.doc: Notifications on and off: turning on rings the bell from its top, with the clapper lagging behind; turning off strikes it through.

components.name: HeartIcon
components.doc: Like: the heart fills with a pop, and a ring and a few sparks burst out once. Unliking simply empties it.

components.name: IconMorph
components.doc: One entry point for every morphing icon: pick it by `name` and drive it with `state`.

members.name: state
members.doc: The second state of the icon. menu: close, play: pause, plus: check, copy: check, theme: moon, chevron: turned, bell: notifications on, heart: liked.

members.name: size
members.doc: Rendered size in px. Defaults to 24.

members.name: strokeWidth
members.doc: Stroke width in the 24 unit grid. Defaults to 1.75.

types.name: IconMorphProps
types.doc: A family of icons that morph between two states instead of swapping. Lines rotate and slide into place, shapes interpolate their outlines, and a few carry a small moment of their own: the bell rings when it turns on and the heart bursts when liked. Every morph rides an interruptible spring, so toggling quickly reverses from wherever the icon is. The icons are decorative; put them inside a button that carries the accessible name and `aria-pressed`.

members.name: turn
members.doc: Degrees the chevron turns when `state` is true. 180 flips down to up; 90 turns right to down.

members.name: pointing
members.doc: Where the chevron points at rest.
